text:
incident-bot: Pager — multigpu-rendezvous: P0: NCCL communicator resets detected on prod-gpu-usw2. 15% job error rate. Pager tagged casey.
casey: I'm on it, joining call. seeing repeated Xid 79 driver errors and containers restarting. Initial ts 2951234567
casey: quick check: all affected pods in ns=redwood-serving cluster=dedicated-usw2 label=model=tp4
jordan: looks like node flaps reported from k8s events: taints added -> kubelet restarted GPUs
maria: we see redispatch errors in the runtime: rendezvous timeouts, then allreduce hang.
vikram: can you paste logs from one of the pods? likely NCCL communicator reset after CUDA error
casey: here's a snippet:

```
[2026-03-14T12:04:33Z] NCCL ERROR Unhandled system error, comm 0x7f8a1, rank 3
[2026-03-14T12:04:33Z] cudaErrorLaunchFailure: unspecified launch failure
[2026-03-14T12:04:33Z] Abort: process exited with code 137 (OOM?)
```

casey: Container restarted 3x within 2m.
jordan: customer-facing: we have ~6 customers in dedicated clusters with increased 5xx (avg 12% requests failed) — PG: enterprise-ml (on Dedicated).
casey: immediate mitigation: evict pods from nodes showing driver XID errors and set to cordon. I'm initiating a cordon/drain on node gpu-usw2-12
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: multigpu-rendezvous -> step1: drain node -> step2: patch driver -> step3: restart kubelet. Confirm when done.
casey: draining now, will scale up fallback pool of single-gpu workers for low-latency routes to avoid customer timeouts.
maria: for model-serving, enable fallback variant model=tp4->tp4-slim single-gpu for canary traffic. Jordan please adjust routing in the console.
jordan: routing change applied: 15% of traffic to tp4-slim, can gradually increase.
vikram: root cause hypothesis: interconnect instability (NVLink) + aggressive contiguous allocation causing CUDA OOM and NCCL to reset communicator; but also saw kernel oops in dmesg.
casey: more logs:

```
[  +0.002345] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  +0.000123] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
```

casey: this matches driver-level resets.
maria: short-term: recommend disabling peer-to-peer NVLink for affected job pools and enable NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME to force network-based collectives. Will prepare a config patch.
vikram: patch ready, posting config:

```
NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
```

casey: applied to canary. monitoring metrics: allreduce latency reduced variance but restarted pods dropped to zero on patched nodes.
jordan: ops note: scaled up single-gpu fallback by 30% and re-routed high-QPS customers.
casey: customer comms: alerted affected tenants via status page (incident-1234). I'll draft a short blurb: there's degraded inference success for some dedicated clusters, mitigation in progress, ETA 90m.
vikram: long-term: need kernel/driver roll forward and add node-level watchdog to preemptively drain on Xid79 spikes. Filing issue: RNW-3256.
maria: also adding an eval to detect deterministic allreduce stalls in our CI harness for TP4-size runs.
casey: handoff: I'm paging oncall for next shift. @vikram @maria please continue follow-ups; I'll update incident timeline and handoff notes.
casey: oncall handoff — summary: multigpu NCCL communicator resets due to GPU driver Xid79 (GPU fell off bus) causing container restarts and allreduce hangs. Mitigations applied: cordon/drain affected nodes, apply NCCL socket fallback patch, scale single-gpu fallback, routing changes. Customer impact: ~6 dedicated customers with increased 5xxs, degraded throughput in some hosted routes. Next steps: driver remediations, node replacement, postmortem.
vikram: noted, will own RNW-3256 driver remediation.
maria: will own CI eval and runtime config recommendations.
incident-bot: Incident update posted to status page; severity P1 -> P2 after mitigations.
casey: thanks, closing initial handoff. keep updates in this thread, add logs in runbook doc link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/multigpu-rendezvous
